name: 97527 · Grants Pass, OR
findings: ZIP 97527 (Grants Pass) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97527 (Grants Pass) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97527 (Grants Pass) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
